projects.title: Aether Roasters - Artisan Coffee Packaging & Identity
projects.short_description: Luxury packaging system and minimalist brand identity for a specialty micro-roastery.
projects.description: Aether Roasters sought a visual identity and packaging system that honored their commitment to single-origin, ethically sourced coffee beans. We developed an embossed matte-black and textured limestone color palette with gold foil stamped typography, custom tasting note labels, and collectible unboxing stationery.
projects.project_objective: Create a distinctive tactile packaging experience that communicates premium artisanal quality on retail shelves.
projects.design_process: Explored geometric letterforms and luxury seal emblems, tested textured sustainable paper substrates, and finalized foil stamping specs.
projects.final_outcome: Elevated brand perception and delivered complete production-ready die-lines and retail packaging standards.

projects.title: Oakwood Capital - Wealth Management Mobile UX & UI
projects.short_description: Modern investment and wealth management interface with refined typography and data visualization.
projects.description: A clean mobile banking and investment experience designed to bring tranquility to financial management. Features personalized portfolio balance breakdowns, intuitive investment trajectory graphs, and tactile card interactions designed for quick comprehension.
projects.project_objective: Simplify complex multi-asset investment tracking into an effortless, trustworthy mobile interface.
projects.design_process: Conducted user journey mapping, designed high-contrast dark theme components, and developed a modular financial card architecture.
projects.final_outcome: Delivered 35+ responsive mobile screens and a comprehensive design system ready for engineering handoff.

projects.title: Monochrome & Terracotta - High Fashion Social Campaign
projects.short_description: Architectural social media editorial grid and multi-slide storytelling campaign.
projects.description: A social media visual campaign for a contemporary autumn fashion collection. Emphasized dramatic editorial crops, oversized serif typography, and a stark black, white, and warm terracotta palette engineered to halt user scrolling.
projects.project_objective: Craft a cohesive, magazine-quality Instagram carousel experience for the Autumn/Winter capsule launch.
projects.design_process: Curated photographer lookbooks, built modular 9-tile layout grids, and balanced bold statement titles with detailed texture shots.
projects.final_outcome: Resulted in a signature aesthetic grid template system deployed across seasonal brand rollouts.

projects.title: Nexus Energy - Sustainable Tech Visual Identity & Guidelines
projects.short_description: Brand identity system, corporate guidelines, and growth marketing collateral for a clean tech company.
projects.description: Nexus Energy pioneers solar microgrids. We built their comprehensive visual identity from the ground up: an organic leaf-circuit mark, a disciplined forest green and charcoal color scheme, a 48-page brand standards guide, and digital marketing banners.
projects.project_objective: Establish a credible, modern visual identity that bridges ecological sustainability with high-tech engineering.
projects.design_process: Drafted iterative logomark concepts, tested legibility at micro scales, and established comprehensive multi-channel brand assets.
projects.final_outcome: A full brand identity system deployed across stationery, marketing decks, website, and physical collateral.
